projects.title: Schedule Engine Dashboard
projects.description: Schedule Engine streamlines home service appointments with its robust booking widget and accompanying web app. I developed the full stack of a multi-page dashboard web app. I implemented modern frontend best practices and accelerated the delivery of new iterations by effectively collaborating with a small dev team.

projects.title: Hoodat
projects.description:
Mobile app to help you remember names and faces by quizzing you. I served as the product owner and lead backend developer on an agile team of four.

This project was completed in Spring 2021 as my capstone project at Messiah University. Feel free to check out the source code on GitHub.

• Spearheaded the development of a mobile app used for name remembering
• Architected and developed the backend REST API service for the app
• Reduced ambiguity through clear documentation and verbal leadership
